<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The only way to infer that without a given structure is to examine the 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically 120‑150 ppm). By counting those distinct signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
